D.treatment: Quiet Eye Training including an EMME video

O.outcome_detail: Expected gaze behavior and novice performance

cells.quote: "In literature on QET, the EMME video is typically an aspect of the full training (i.e., not the main manipulation) aimed at modeling the expected gaze behavior to the novice and contrasting the quiet eye behavior of the novice and the expert"
cells.note: This quote is from the wiki entry, not the supplied study text. The supplied study text identifies a Quiet Eye Training cluster of 19 articles but does not report the comparison, outcome direction, participant characteristics, setting, duration, or effect size for this cluster.

O.outcome_detail: pedagogical efficiency and simplification for students

cells.quote: In the present note we want to plead for using a notation system in the spirit or as close as possible to SI. The pedagogical motivation is obvious. Such a formulation has also the advantage that one can simplify the life of a student who does not consent the general manner of notation.
cells.note: The study presents a theoretical pedagogical argument, not an empirical comparison or measured learning outcome.

D.treatment: QED teaching sequence with a dialogic teacher stance

cells.quote: Considerando alguns indicadores presentes na literatura para avaliar indícios de alfabetização científica e de engajamento dos estudantes, veremos que a sequência, quando aliada a uma postura dialógica por parte do(a) docente, pode proporcionar elevados índices de engajamento e indícios de alfabetização científica.
cells.note: The study reports indicators of scientific literacy during the intervention, but does not state a comparison condition or provide a printed effect size.
